claims: Dunkin' is giving away 1 million free coffees to Dunkin' Rewards members on April 21, 2026.
The Dunkin' free coffees giveaway starts at 9 a.m. local time on April 21, 2026.
Users must enter the promo code "FREECOFFEE1" in the Dunkin' mobile app to claim a free medium hot or iced coffee.
The free coffee certificate is valid for seven days after entry.
Dunkin' Rewards membership is free to join.
Cold Brew and Extra-Large Hot Coffees are not included in the promotion.
The promotion limit is one per customer while supplies last.
USA Today reported a similar promotion in April 2026.
